nodes.label: Captio Login Page (EN) - Sign In UI Screenshot
nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio application login page displayed in English. Centered card layout on a light gray background. The card features the Captio logo with tagline 'intake · brief · equipo', a 'Sign in' heading, subtitle 'Access for the firm’s team only.', Email and Password input fields, a blue gradient 'Sign in' CTA button, and a language switcher showing ES and EN options (EN currently active). Clean minimal design with white rounded card on pale gray page background.

nodes.label: Captio Authentication Feature
nodes.description: Email and password authentication flow for Captio, restricted to firm team members only.

nodes.label: Language Switcher (ES/EN)
nodes.description: UI toggle allowing users to switch between Spanish (ES) and English (EN) on the login page.
